policy: Exact original event URL, event title, venue, and local date are required; external links are human-reviewed format/genre evidence, never blind genre inference. No arbitrary other events are labeled from venue or artist reputation. Added eight exact 2026 High Water Mark original event IDs after independent concert-format verification; generic recurring activities are not reclassified.
